metadata.name: ai.quickdeploy/smb-month-end-close
metadata.title: SMB Month-End Close
metadata.description: Read-only cross-app close: reconcile processors against the books, build the packet.

skill.name: smb-month-end-close
skill.description: Drive a small business's month-end close across QuickBooks, Stripe, Square, and Shopify — pull the period's numbers, reconcile processor totals against the books, flag missing receipts and discrepancies, and produce an owner/accountant review packet — strictly read-only.

env.name: STRIPE_API_KEY
env.description: Stripe secret key; test keys by default.

env.name: SQUARE_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Square access token; sandbox by default.

env.name: SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN
env.description: Shopify Admin token; dev store by default.

env.name: QBO_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: QuickBooks OAuth2 refresh token; sandbox company by default.
